operations.name: Track a segment event
operations.description: Send a Segment track event from an external page or app. Events are sent server-side through ramp.com's Segment source and respect the visitor's privacy opt-out (Global Privacy Control or the ramp.com data privacy opt-out cookie). Send JSON as `application/json` or `text/plain` (e.g. with `navigator.sendBeacon`), and use `credentials: 'include'` to default `anonymousId` to the ramp_web_id cookie.

event.description: Segment event name. Reuse an existing ramp.com event such as "Marketing Site CTA Clicked" where possible.

properties.description: Event properties. At most 50 keys, keys up to 100 characters, and 8 KB when serialized as JSON.

anonymousId.description: Segment anonymous ID. Defaults to the ramp_web_id cookie when the request includes it; required otherwise.

page.description: Page the event happened on. Defaults to the referer header when omitted.
